description: This file contains utility functions for the FastAPI framework, including handling model fields, response codes, path parameters, operation ID generation, and deep dictionary updates. It also manages internal caches and type checks related to Pydantic models.

methods.name: bool is_body_allowed_for_status_code(status_code: Union[int, str, None])
methods.description: Determines if the HTTP response body is allowed for a given status code according to the OpenAPI specification.

methods.name: set[str] get_path_param_names(path: str)
methods.description: Extracts dynamic path parameter names from a URL path string.

methods.name: ModelField create_model_field( name: str, type_: Any, class_validators: Optional[dict[str, Validator]] = None, default: Optional[Any] = Undefined, required: Union[bool, UndefinedType] = Undefined, model_config: Union[type[BaseConfig], None] = None, field_info: Optional[FieldInfo] = None, alias: Optional[str] = None, mode: Literal["validation", "serialization"] = "validation", version: Literal["1", "auto"] = "auto", )
methods.description: Creates a Pydantic ModelField with specific configurations, ensuring compatibility with FastAPI and Pydantic.

methods.name: ModelField create_cloned_field( field: ModelField, *, cloned_types: Optional[MutableMapping[type[BaseModel], type[BaseModel]]] = None, )
methods.description: Returns a cloned version of a ModelField; currently returns the same field.

methods.name: str generate_operation_id_for_path( *, name: str, path: str, method: str )
methods.description: Generates a unique operation ID based on route name, path, and method. Deprecated and warns if used.

methods.name: str generate_unique_id(route: "APIRoute")
methods.description: Creates a unique identifier for an API route based on its name, path, and method.

methods.name: None deep_dict_update(main_dict: dict[Any, Any], update_dict: dict[Any, Any])
methods.description: Recursively updates one dictionary with another, merging nested dicts and concatenating lists.

methods.name: Union[DefaultPlaceholder,DefaultType] get_value_or_default( first_item: Union[DefaultPlaceholder, DefaultType], *extra_items: Union[DefaultPlaceholder, DefaultType], )
methods.description: Returns the first item that is not a DefaultPlaceholder, or the first item if all are placeholders.
